specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art-direction concept for the SCENE ONLY of a Chinese browser space-trading management game, not an interface mockup. Create a premium, carefully art-directed MINIATURE 3D SHIPPING DIORAMA in a wide landscape 16:10 composition. This is a game world map with four clearly different commerce destinations, all visible at once at approximately the same zoom. Deep desaturated midnight navy space, subtle dusty warm light and a few precise stars, restrained bloom. The planets and facilities are beautifully crafted, readable, polished models, not crude low-poly rocks and not blurry texture noise.
Composition: top-left area is a modest warm sun around 20% x, 25% y, about 5% of image width. Agriculture planet center near 36% x, 40% y, diameter about 13% of width: glossy blue oceans, olive and sage continents, softly sculpted cream clouds, fine farmland patches and a distinctive cream orbital loading dock attached at lower right. Mining hub near 71% x, 36% y, a handsome large faceted ochre asteroid, two smaller rocks, recognizable drill rig and cargo gantry, around 13% of image width. Industrial world near 60% x, 69% y, copper colored globe with clear dark factory clusters, warm tiny window lights, docks and one small orbital ring, about 13% of width. Cold jade material depot near 29% x, 71% y: clustered pale teal mineral bodies with a well-designed warehouse and shipping landing deck, clearly distinguishable from the mining hub by SILHOUETTE, around 12% of width.
Thin elegant curved gold and slate route lines connect agriculture to mining to industrial to depot, plus agriculture to industrial; two tiny yet distinct cream cargo ships on routes. Routes stay behind the planets. Each object must be completely visible with generous negative space around it. Consistent light direction from upper left, warm highlights, cool ambient shadows; good midtone visibility rather than crushed blacks. Sophisticated tactile clay-painted metal aesthetic, crisp silhouettes and enough detail to feel inhabited. Orthographic fixed oblique game-camera projection, balanced layout, no cinematic perspective distortion. Keep top 6% and bottom 11% as unobtrusive space to allow EXISTING game chrome to overlay later.
No text, no letters, no captions, no labels, no badge outlines, no panels, no buttons, no frames, no icons, no watermark, NO UI. This image is only the scene behind an unchanged existing user interface. Do not depict a moodboard or a multi-panel collage. One finished full-width game map scene.
specs.revisionPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Input image: scene composition reference and edit target. Preserve the four destinations, their broad layout and the connecting trade routes.
Change the ART MEDIUM decisively. Redraw this as a polished STYLIZED MINIATURE CLAY AND PAINTED-METAL 3D GAME DIORAMA. It should look clearly like a charming handcrafted scale model, distinctly different from realistic space concept art. Rounded crafted shapes, large clean color blocks, satin painted surfaces, simple beautiful material shading, softly sculpted clouds, conspicuous miniature warehouses and cargo cranes. Agriculture is a beautiful blue-green toy globe with cream cloud puffs, gentle green patchwork fields, and a miniature cream shipping dock. Mining is a chunky large ochre mineral crystal with a miniature industrial drill rig. Industry is a terracotta miniature factory planet with crisp simplified rooftops and tiny glowing windows. Depot is a pale jade crystal cluster with a handsome cream warehouse. All ports are inhabited, beautifully designed, and unmistakably different.
Lighting: warm soft studio key light with cool fill, readable midtones and lovely highlight edges. Background must be a mostly SIMPLE FLAT VERY DARK DESATURATED NAVY with a faint broad soft haze and a few small stars. Greatly remove the photorealistic nebula textures, remove nearly all peripheral asteroids and tiny unrelated moons. Avoid realism, noisy surface detail, crater photographs, heavy lens flares, dense starfield and excessive bloom. This is elegant miniature strategy-game art with visible craft and polish, not rough low-poly placeholders and not a gritty sci-fi cinematic painting.
Retain a wide 16:10 map composition, four fully visible destinations at the same overview scale, a modest small warm sun upper left, and two tiny cleanly modeled cargo ships. No text, NO UI, no panels, no buttons, no labels, no letters, no watermark. Keep top 6% and bottom 11% low detail for unchanged existing game UI.

specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SCENE-ONLY concept for a browser space trading management game. Create a premium CINEMATIC SEMI-REALISTIC STELLAR TRADE ATLAS, in one wide 16:10 landscape image. Beautiful spatial depth and convincing celestial materials, but clearly a readable game map with FOUR SMALL destinations all visible at the same time, never a close-up of one enormous planet. The surrounding existing UI will be overlaid separately and must not be invented here.
Composition coordinates: a small warm golden sun at 20% x,25% y, diameter about 5% of image width. At 36% x,40% y an Earthlike agricultural world diameter 13% width: richly resolved cyan-blue ocean, green land, pearly cloud bands, precise narrow atmospheric rim, the terminator kept gentle enough to see the terrain, a sophisticated orbital cargo station in the lit lower-right rim. At 71% x,36% y a rugged amber asteroid mining port 13% width: refined craters, tiny neighboring rocks, believable industrial scaffold and a docking pier. At 60% x,69% y a copper industrial planet diameter 13% width with distinct city and factory clusters in the evening hemisphere and soft ember windows, elegant orbital shipyards. At 29% x,71% y a JADE icy ore depot, about 12% width, icy fractured mineral moonlets and a cold illuminated warehouse station, distinct silhouette from the asteroid mine.
Background is elegant near-black blue space with a restrained broad wispy mauve/amber nebula behind and to the side of the destinations, high-quality star field with sparse bright stars, no dense glitter and no lens flare wash. Thin muted amber curved trade routes agriculture->mine->industry->depot and agriculture->industry. Two small silver-ivory cargo vessels, readable in silhouette, sit on routes without dominating. Atmospheric glows are tight and subtle, no huge selection halos. High-quality physically plausible directional sunlight, cool bounce light keeps ports readable. High-end strategy-game key art, coherent scale, crisp forms and rich texture, calm and beautiful, not action-battle art.
Fixed oblique overview camera, all four destinations are fully in frame with comfortable margins. Keep the top 6% and bottom 11% unobtrusive for original game chrome. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no UI, no panels, no controls, no overlays, no logo, no watermark, no collage. One finished scene, not an illustration of a monitor.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: scene-only art-direction concept for a browser space-trading management game. Create a sophisticated HAND-PAINTED INTERSTELLAR COMMERCE MAP, a wide 16:10 landscape composition. Distinctively illustrated 2.5D art, not photorealistic and not flat technical schematics. Beautiful controlled brushwork, softly shaded geometric forms, subtle print grain, delicate warm brass route lines and individually recognizable port buildings. Think beautifully illustrated strategic board game world art, restrained adult aesthetic, warm pale stone and terracotta against deep indigo. The image must show four compact destinations all fully visible with generous negative space.
A small honey-gold sun at 20% x,25% y, about 5% of image width. Agriculture globe at 36% x,40% y, about 13% width: layered teal oceans and sage/jade continents, simplified pale cloud curls, hand-painted farmland shapes, a cream harbor ring. Amber asteroid mine at 71% x,36% y, about 13% width: a sculpted faceted main asteroid and three satellite pieces, bold readable ochre drill platform and cranes. Terracotta industrial globe at 60% x,69% y, about 13% width: graphic but dimensional factories integrated into the globe, blue-gray rooftops, small cream-lit windows, a handsome long shipping pier. Jade ore depot at 29% x,71% y, about 12% width: a distinct clustered icy mineral silhouette and large pale warehouse roofs with teal shipping platforms. Each destination should have a deliberate, beautiful identifiable silhouette rather than generic dots or plain balls.
Curved thin copper-gold trade routes connect agriculture->mine->industry->depot with agriculture->industry as a quieter route. Two tiny cream-white illustrated freighters with visible cabin/cargo proportions and short subtle engine trails. The background is deep warm indigo with soft printed nebula forms, few tiny finely placed stars, no glowing neon grid. Stable diagonal soft lighting, bright enough to read all surfaces, a little ambient depth. Editorial illustration craftsmanship, polished cohesive art direction, no heavy black outlines, no simplistic clip-art, no toy plastic 3D rendering.
Fixed oblique overview, no perspective horizon. Top 6% and bottom 11% remain unobtrusive for existing game chrome. No words, no labels, no numbers, no icons, no frames, no UI controls, no cards, no legend, no logo, no watermark. Single complete game map scene, not a collage or a poster.
